scope: Production Solidity, all medium/high detectors and all severities of five reentrancy detectors. Each finding is retained, individually reviewed, and bound to exact source/configuration/dependency hashes. This is an internal review, not an independent audit.

slither-extended.json.location: ENSJobPages.migrateLegacyWrappedJobPage(uint256,string).adopted (contracts/ens/ENSJobPages.sol#278) is a local variable never initialized
slither-extended.json.rationale: The event flag intentionally starts false and is set true only after existing wrapped ownership is successfully adopted. Solidity initializes scalar locals to their type default; no uninitialized storage pointer is involved.

slither-extended.json.location: ENSJobPages.handleHook(uint8,uint256).success (contracts/ens/ENSJobPages.sol#363) is a local variable never initialized
slither-extended.json.rationale: Each best-effort ENS operation intentionally starts with a false result and sets true only inside a successful try branch. Solidity initializes scalar locals to their type default; no uninitialized storage pointer is involved.

slither-extended.json.location: AGIJobManager._settleValidators(AGIJobManager.Job,bool,uint256,uint256,uint256) (contracts/AGIJobManager.sol#1343-1389) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
slither-extended.json.rationale: The slash is intentionally floored for each incorrect validator. Multiplying that per-validator slash by the incorrect-validator count exactly equals the sum withheld from individual bonds; multiplying before flooring could allocate more than was withheld. Remaining USDC is routed to the winning party.

slither-extended.json.location: AGIJobPages._resolveTokenURI(uint256) (contracts/periphery/AGIJobPages.sol#101-109) calls abi.encodePacked() with multiple dynamic arguments:
slither-extended.json.rationale: Intentional literal URI concatenation of an owner-configured base and a decimal job ID, optionally followed by .json. The concatenated value does not authorize a user, validate a signature, or identify escrow.

slither-extended.json.location: AGIJobManager._cancelJobAndRefund(uint256,AGIJobManager.Job) (contracts/AGIJobManager.sol#617-623) deletes AGIJobManager.Job (contracts/AGIJobManager.sol#365-393) which contains a mapping:
slither-extended.json.rationale: Cancellation/delisting requires an unassigned job. Voting requires assignment and completion, so approvals/disapprovals mappings have no populated entries on this deletion path. Job IDs advance monotonically and are not reused. Both external cancellation entry points hold the reentrancy guard.

slither-extended.json.location: ENSJobPages._buildJobLabel(string,uint256) (contracts/ens/ENSJobPages.sol#755-759) calls abi.encodePacked() with multiple dynamic arguments:
slither-extended.json.rationale: The operation builds the literal ENS label rather than an authentication digest. Prefix validation requires a nonnumeric final character, decimal job IDs delimit the suffix, and snapshotted label ownership rejects reuse across jobs.

slither-extended.json.location: ReputationMath.computeReputationPoints(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,bool).timeBonus (contracts/utils/ReputationMath.sol#22) is a local variable never initialized
slither-extended.json.rationale: The integer bonus intentionally starts at zero when no positive duration-based bonus applies. Solidity initializes scalar locals to their type default; no uninitialized storage pointer is involved.

slither-extended.json.location: Reentrancy in AGIJobManager._settleValidators(AGIJobManager.Job,bool,uint256,uint256,uint256) (contracts/AGIJobManager.sol#1343-1389):
slither-extended.json.rationale: The post-transfer write is validator reputation, not escrow authority. All settlement entry points hold nonReentrant and terminal state/reserve debits precede transfers. Native Circle USDC transfer does not invoke recipient hooks; a view of reputation cannot reenter guarded money-moving paths. This review does not approve substituting an arbitrary callback token.

slither-reentrancy.json.rationale: These are best-effort ENS metadata events after configured ENS/resolver calls or an onlySelf dispatch. Metadata entry points require onlyOwner, onlyJobManager, or onlySelf; an ordinary external callback cannot assume those roles. A compromised owner-selected integration can affect its own metadata/event ordering, but these events do not authorize USDC movement. Consumers must use manager job state and transaction/log order for settlement truth.

This manager path executes under a nonReentrant external entry point. Incoming transfers are counted only after the exact balance delta is verified; outgoing paths commit terminal state/reserve debits before interactions. Completion NFT callbacks cannot enter guarded settlement/withdrawal/wallet-rotation paths. Canonical USDC is fixed and no arbitrary callback token is approved for production.
